scope: Day 14 deterministic execution checkpoint with explicit case/run denominators
source_state: Uncommitted Day 13 and Day 14 changes on local-readiness-plan; no commit or push for this checkpoint.

implementation.test_repair: Replace the three-letter fake bearer token with a non-hexadecimal fixture token so legitimate random session IDs cannot falsely fail full-report redaction checks.
implementation.ci: Separate Python 3.12 execution job runs --repeat 10 --execution-gate and retains reports on failure.
implementation.gate: Fewer than 100 distinct mission cases, fewer than 1000 mission executions, or any failed contract returns nonzero.
implementation.empty_or_duplicate_case_inflation_checks: Repeated single cases, component-only counts, insufficient run counts and failed contracts are tested.

execution_gate.qualification: Deterministic checkpoint only; held-out, crash-recovery and workload gates remain separate.

campaign.trace_checks: Every mission scenario verifies flush, published status order, failure attribution, dispatch attempts, cancel requests and zero trace loss.

planning.qualification: Development planning only; excluded from deterministic execution counts.

held_out.refusal: no cases in held_out; do not substitute development data

reused_ros_evidence.reason: Only the offline fault CLI and its new scenario module changed; all existing ROS runtime sources and four ROS check scripts match.

cancellation_ms.method: nearest-rank; monotonic command callback receipt to async cancel API return

earlier_attempts.harness_calibration: Initial fixture failures are preserved: choice expiry also expired localization, a wrong context field name, and an assertion that matched the boundary notice word older. Fixtures were corrected; production thresholds and outcomes were not relaxed.
earlier_attempts.interrupted_campaign: Original campaign had no final report after task resumption; it contributes zero executions to this result.
earlier_attempts.interrupted_unit_suite: Original unit log and empty XML/coverage outputs were incomplete; no pass is claimed from them. Fresh resumed artifacts supply the final result.

release_status.gate1: partial: active-goal crash reconciliation and full-workload cancellation remain unqualified
release_status.gate2: unqualified: independent held-out data and live-model campaign missing

limits: Deterministic forced event ordering does not establish concurrent race, physics, actual Gazebo motion or physical stopping behavior.
Expected refusals are passing contracts, not successful navigation missions.
Scripted clarification verifies history construction, not arbitrary model interpretation.
Three standalone component scenarios and 24 development planning cases are excluded from mission execution counts.
No new ROS/Gazebo integration runs: unchanged Day 13 middleware checks were reused with source and report hash verification.
No hosted CI, Python 3.10/3.11 runtime, endurance, full-workload cancellation or new crash-recovery qualification.
Raw artifacts are local under ignored simulation/artifacts; this manifest retains their counts and hashes.
deferred_live_product_missions: Five live-model Gazebo missions remain paused as requested.
